<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Close a loading load (create a closure)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/loads/{loadId}/closures"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Moves a `LOADING` load to `CLOSED` and publishes `LoadClosed` with
the package and short-shipped counts. A load closes only when every
assigned package is loaded or short-shipped with a reason: any
package still outstanding is `409 packages-outstanding`
(`ErrPackagesOutstanding`). Short-ships are recorded in the same
command, each with its reason; an entry without a `package_id` or a
`reason` is `400 bad-request` and nothing is changed. A package the
diversion policy already short-shipped is recorded once: with the
reason of the entry that names it, else `DIVERTED`.
